claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, for n = ceil(log2 N), the central-band collimation algorithm in proof.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than 0.98 on independent clean copies. On every execution branch, charged total work is O(2^((9/4) sqrt(n log2 n))) with an absolute constant. The envelope growth index is exactly 1/2; the bound holds jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims.

For every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, for n = ceil(log2 N), the central-band collimation algorithm in proof.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than 0.98 on independent clean copies. On every execution branch, peak allocated classical bits is O(n^2) with an absolute constant. The envelope growth index is exactly 0; the bound holds jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims.

For every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, for n = ceil(log2 N), the central-band collimation algorithm in proof.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than 0.98 on independent clean copies. On every execution branch, peak allocated qubits is O(n) with an absolute constant. The envelope growth index is exactly 0; the bound holds jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims.

For every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, for n = ceil(log2 N), the central-band collimation algorithm in proof.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than 0.98 on independent clean copies. On every execution branch, total acquired samples including all attempts and discarded states is O(2^((9/8) sqrt(n log2 n))) with an absolute constant. The envelope growth index is exactly 1/2; the bound holds jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims.

For every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, for n = ceil(log2 N), the central-band collimation algorithm in proof.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than 0.98 on independent clean copies. The guaranteed fractional tolerance is epsilon(n)=0 among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires all obtained source copies to be fresh independent ideal DCP states for the same secret and modulus. All four resource guarantees hold jointly on every execution branch.
